text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — we've got ~140 leads in last 24h that didn't get a HubSpot owner during 21:00–07:00 EMEA. Noticed spike after enrichment timeout.
Alex Kim: saw sample — enrichment webhook 504 -> HS workflow bounced to fallback who?
Sam Ortiz: looks like round-robin was paused for 1h during deploy yesterday, fallback owner config is empty for that window :grimace:
Eli Newman: can we set immediate fallback to "team:inbound-overflow" pool? Otherwise leads stay unassigned until manual claim.
Maya Patel: agreed. quick patch proposal:
```json
{ "hubspot": { "workflowId": 98765, "fallbackOwner": "team:inbound-overflow", "claim_timeout_sec": 300 } }
```
Alex Kim: adding smaller tweak — if enrichment fails, add tag `enrich_failed` and route to overflow with TTL 48h.
Sam Ortiz: ✓ Also add debounce so duplicate enrichment jobs don't requeue every 30s.
inbound-bot: Deploy scheduled: rollout start 2026-03-21T02:15Z by alexk — will patch workflow fallback.
Alex Kim: deploying patch now, will monitor claim rate and queue length.
Maya Patel: thanks. can someone add a one-liner to the handoff SLA doc re: quiet-hours fallback? we want SLA: 95% assigned within 15m even in EMEA night.
Eli Newman: noted. I’ll PR to playbook and ping sales ops.
Sam Ortiz: post-deploy checks: `hs crm -> workflows -> check fallback owner`, `sf mapping -> downstream owner field`, `monitor -> inbound_queue.unassigned_count`.
Maya Patel: if anything spikes escalate to #sales immediately. :loud_sound:
Alex Kim: done. numbers looking good so far — unassigned dropped from 142 -> 12 in 10m.
Sam Ortiz: filing follow-up ticket: HS-1127 (round-robin resume + enrichment backoff).
Maya Patel: great, closing thread for now. will add timeline to weekly recap.
